purpose: Apply canonical DLC/addon/content eligibility while keeping purchase-family membership separate from independent Taste/dossier semantic scope.

rules.sub_package: eligible_for_family_resolution only when at least one contained app or the feed representative app is taste-include in the same run; otherwise unresolved and fail closed
rules.dlc_purchase_family_membership: may preserve exact Steam base/addon purchase relationships without creating an independent Taste semantic subject
rules.dlc_independent_taste_dossier_scope: eligible only after reliable product metadata positively confirms substantial playable narrative/story content
rules.dlc_story_scope_ambiguous: exclude from independent Taste/dossier scope as story_content_unproven_excluded
rules.dlc_confirmed_non_story: exclude from independent Taste/dossier scope as non_story_dlc_excluded
rules.story_dlc_after_scope_gate: existing base-support/final recommendation condition remains downstream and separate from story-scope classification
rules.season_pass_or_entitlement_container: not an independent story DLC semantic object solely because it grants story DLC children

pass_requires: all 101 current taste includes are classified
all exclusions use canonical content eligibility reason codes
checkpoint proof is current and complete

story_dlc_scope.positive_evidence_source: GitHub-accessible Steam product metadata; title alone cannot prove eligibility
